s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of purpuric lesions with systemic involvement and multi-organ dysfunction
salient_findings: Purpuric lesions on face, elbows, knees, and feet
Skin sloughing off lesions on elbows and knees
Reticulated purpuric macules and patches on extensor surfaces
Dusky purpuric macules and patches on nose, cheeks, forehead, and ear
key_facts: Patient has a history of nonischemic cardiomyopathy
Patient has chronic kidney disease
Patient presented with altered mental status after an unwitnessed fall
New lesions developed on nose, ear, and extensor surfaces of arms
Hypercalcemia with calcium level of 11.5 mg/dL
Acute kidney injury with creatinine level of 5.6 mg/dL
Rouleaux and cryoprotein precipitate on peripheral blood smear
Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
Elevated serum cryoglobulin levels with cryocrit of 16%
Biopsy showed intravascular fibrinoid material with cryoglobulins and fibrin thrombi
CT scan of pelvis revealed lytic bony lesions
Bone marrow biopsy showed hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells and κ-light-chain restriction
